mapper.select: SELECT ft.function_name, ft.request_url, ft.request_method, ft.fee_type, ft.unit_price, ft.function_id, tf.tenant_id,tf.expire_time FROM sys_function_tenant ft LEFT JOIN sys_tenant_function tf ON ft.function_id = tf.function_id WHERE ft.state = 'ONLINE'

SELECT ft.function_name, ft.request_url, ft.request_method, ft.fee_type, ft.unit_price, ft.function_id, tf.tenant_id FROM sys_function_tenant ft INNER JOIN sys_tenant_function tf ON ft.function_id = tf.function_id WHERE ft.state = 'ONLINE' AND ft.fee_type = 'MONTH'
